name: Stud and nut sets (production tree)
function: The stud and nut sets between every flange of the production tree; the same hardware family as the frac stack.

tabs.overview: One node in the model for all the stud sets; see the wellhead stud bolt record for materials and make-up practice.
tabs.engineering: Per API 6A; sized to the flange.
tabs.safety: Made up to the specified torque or stretch.
